summary: Two genuine SteamVR IVRScreenshots stereo captures show the generated HEVC VR180 spheres in both eyes at different animation positions with valid tracking. Tracking was intermittent; initial blank and off-center results are retained. No subjective viewing claim.

fixture.stereoLayout: left-right SBS, each eye 3840x3840 equirectangular hemisphere, longitude -90..90 and latitude -90..90 degrees
fixture.generationDetail: Ray-traced spheres at 640x640 per eye, upscaled to 3840x3840 per eye for hardware decode path; low bitrate synthetic fixture, not native-detail/high-bitrate 8K stress content. Stereo/projection layout is specified by player; no MP4 spatial metadata.

publicCandidate.result: Source identifies stereo 360, so unsuitable to prove HEVC VR180. Saved public-demo-source.html; third-party site compatibility not tested.

finalHeadset.captureAPI: OpenVR IVRScreenshots_001 RequestScreenshot type=2; genuine final stereo compositor output, not browser framebuffer
finalHeadset.visualInspection: Yellow sphere moves from left of center to right of center between captures. Red and turquoise spheres and spherical grid appear in both eyes. Stereo eye differences are visible. Final screenshots crop a narrower field than the direct XR framebuffer captures.

diagnostics.result: Native readback false during captures. Immediate CDP promise result remained true briefly; native later samples establish actual transition.

diagnostics.action: One normal handlewakeup in each short session; no power setting change
diagnostics.result: Valid and invalid tracking samples both occurred; cannot attribute tracking recovery solely to wake.

diagnostics.action: Test-player-only recenter on first real non-emulated pose during short repeat
diagnostics.result: Reset initialRotation once using existing player algorithm and actual pose. Fixed edge-of-hemisphere view after first session initialized from an invalid identity pose. Does not alter runtime tracking, build, or on-disk index.html. Exact code in centered.py.

limitations: Tracking intermittently invalid; this is a bounded successful picture/motion check, not a stable-tracking certification.
Synthetic low-bitrate upscaled HEVC fixture; no public website or native-detail high-bitrate 8K claim.
Video quality counters are browser counters, not instrumented hardware decode counts.
Two still captures animated at 1 fps show changed content, not real-time playback smoothness.
No production changes, docs/PR edits outside requested evidence, commit/push, or redelegation. No independent review per worker instruction.
